node.title: F1 pole/tower descent preserves the RS rate
node.statement: In the F1 extension-pole and tower constructions, base-field restriction and Weil expansion preserve the evaluation domain D and RS degree bound kappa. Therefore every imported base-list threshold has the same rate kappa/|D| as its ambient row. Clean-rate pole pricing consumes only clean-rate list crossings; rate-half list adjacency is needed only for an ambient rate-half row.
node.notes: Resolves roadmap Conflict-4. This is a per-rate scope router, not a proof of any list crossing or extension upper bound. The global all-rate dependency remains sound for the full prize.
